prediction.predicted_outcome: A bounded propose-validate-accept harness-edit loop raises held-out task pass rate over a frozen harness by a small but positive margin (+3 to +8 points absolute) on the fixed suite with the fixed base model; among the three single editable surfaces, context-management logic yields the largest verified gain, tool-invocation policy second, workflow control flow smallest.
prediction.action_if_confirmed: Fix context-management logic as the v2 surface and spend the remaining agenda budget on a larger held-out split and a second base model to test whether the same accepted edit transfers.
prediction.action_if_refuted: Drop the surface-ranking hypothesis and re-scope v2 to the weaker question of whether ANY single-surface bounded edit beats the frozen harness at all, with a wider weakness-mining budget and a per-surface null-result report.
prediction.already_published_evidence: Frontier packet 2 (agenda 7, gate_allowed, independent evaluator sora2_claude/claude-opus-4-6-thinking, coverage 2026-04-08..2026-05-13, 24 linked papers) found no prior work answering this question: EvoMAS 2605.08769 evolves execution-time workflows without a non-regression gate, RewardHarness 2605.08703 targets post-training rather than bounded harness edits, MemFlow 2605.03312 isolates context management alone without cross-surface comparison, Squeeze Evolve 2604.07725 and Uno-Orchestra 2605.05007 orchestrate multi-model systems without a controlled single-surface ablation, and 2605.05716 demonstrates cross-component interference but runs no bounded edit loop.

minimum_falsification_experiment.metric: held-out task pass rate under the fixed verifier, with held-in pass rate as the non-regression guard
minimum_falsification_experiment.baseline: frozen harness (zero accepted edits), identical base model, identical task suite, identical seeds
minimum_falsification_experiment.decisive_comparison: pre-registered 60/40 held-in/held-out split fixed before any run; at most one accepted edit per surface; 3 seeds; a surface counts as a win only if held-out pass rate improves AND neither split regresses beyond the pre-registered tolerance; the three surfaces are ranked by held-out delta and the ranking claim requires non-overlapping 95% CIs
